states.name: 실제 퍼즐
states.contract: Select cell/clue → unused tile click. Correct tile locks immediately and advances in the same word. Wrong tile is not placed or consumed. Unused puzzle cells stay blocked.

states.name: 도움1
states.contract: Reveal length, starting position and masked Korean example. Record help for actual word occurrence; no automatic placement or currency debit.

states.name: 도움2
states.contract: Select shared crossing cell, record help for implicated crossing words; preserve clue/grid direction synchronization.

states.name: 도움3
states.contract: Reveal only one target syllable. User still selects and places the real unused tile. Do not fill a solved cell.

states.name: 방망이 접촉
states.contract: Actual video position667/1300ms determines contact; then existing board border emphasis100+150+900ms. Not a timer started from button press. Missing/failed clip leaves learning controls usable.

states.name: 오답·다시 시도
states.contract: No placement or tile consumption on wrong click. Preserve selected cell/clue and explicit readable retry feedback.

states.name: 단어 완성·다시 듣기
states.contract: Correct sound and TTS of answer plus reconstructed Korean example. Completed words remain replayable; letter/meaning alone is not the full audio contract.

states.name: 신규게임 결과
states.contract: Save practice completion, then actual XP/best, then success receipt. Normal game+30 XP only after persisted award. No invented Yeopjeon amount or Dancheong ownership.

states.name: 기록 복습 결과
states.contract: Replay source is validated; record independent/assisted completion but do not change game XP/best.

states.name: 저장 실패·재시도
states.contract: Suppress confirmed-success/reward labels until durable stages finish. Retry same attempt; fence duplicates, account change and old async work.

states.name: 수준 선택
states.contract: Actual A1–C2 selection applies immediately, uses stored per-level progress and intended puzzle. No new Apply gate or silent award.

states.name: 선택적 도깨비 소개
states.contract: Existing fixed frame,16 flame phases over1.8s, supplied intro clip and replay. Optional culture introduction, separate from gameplay help/contact/reward.

states.name: 세로 단어 선택
states.contract: Synchronize selected clue2, vertical3-syllable word and3 connected empty cells. The shared first cell keeps seals1 and2. No reveal or reward on selection.

states.name: 첫 정답 타일·아직0단어
states.contract: Place and lock 어 in first cell, disable only the used pool tile and advance to 제. Count remains0/3 words; do not award XP or trigger full-word completion audio yet.

states.name: 넓은 퍼즐·큰 글자
states.contract: C design must reserve at least48dp real tile targets at320dp/200% and5 columns; move character above if needed and make explicit scroll content. Side formula1800 cases is not actual Flutter rendering proof.

states.name: 로딩·재시도
states.contract: Preserve visible loader/error/retry, per-item invalid-data handling and bundle cache reset.

states.name: 빈 수준·유효하지 않은 복습
states.contract: Never fabricate a playable puzzle, old result, solved state or award; provide current safe return/retry path.

states.name: 음성 실패·오프라인
states.contract: Puzzle data is local; un-cached audio is not guaranteed offline. Keep puzzle usable and expose replay/retry without falsely confirming audio success.

states.name: 마지막 퍼즐
states.contract: Preserve next/remaining-level, Sarangbang and stored practice-history choices. Use actual completion counts; do not force next-level mastery.

states.name: 진행 중 이탈
states.contract: Existing confirmation remains; no promise of automatic mid-grid restore.

states.name: 모션 감소·인터럽트
states.contract: Use original reduced-motion behavior and cleanup/late-callback guards. Keep input/help accessible during failed media, background and return.
